hero.filename: Birmingham Pub Bombings Memorial - Birmingham New Street Station (45092365705).jpg
hero.caption:
Seen at the public square outside of Birmingham New Street Station is the Birmingham Pub Bombings Memorial.
It was unveiled on the evening of the 21st November 2018, 44 years to the day that the attack happened at two pubs on New Street.
The artwork is by Anuradha Patel.

There is 21 stainless steel leaves with the names of the victims on them.
